The aim of this study is to evaluate whether serum cystatin C is related to arterial stiffness independently of serum creatinine in subjects for whom serum creatinine is normal. A total of 2,018 individuals (1,120 males, 898 females) were enrolled. Mean brachial-ankle pulse wave velocity (baPWV) was used as a marker of arterial stiffness and sex-specific analysis was performed.
